correctness.rationale: For q≡1 mod4 odd, d=(q-1)/4>=2, the d-th power map has image mu4 and fibers d. Every zero sum of up to four fourth roots is classified using A+Bi and norm A²+B²<17; supports c2=24 and c4=36 for p>=7, with extra c3=16 at p=3, and c3=48,c4=52 at p=5. This yields #X by divided scalar action. Separately, same-family line intersections form 6d points incident d times, cross-family intersections 3d³ points incident twice, yielding U=9d³+6d and N1=6d³. Subtracting gives the claimed off-line regimes. Independent enumeration of four-root sums for p=3,5,7,13,17,29 and all F13/F17/F29 projective points confirmed full incidence spectra. Special q=9,d=2 merger checked in the proof, not extrapolated from p>=7 enumeration.
